fill in the blank she was tired that she.whyCorrect: "so ... that" is the correlative construction for a result: so + adjective + that + clause (so tired that she could not walk).

wrong.B: "very tired that ..." is ungrammatical; "very" does not take a that-clause.
wrong.C: "too" takes the "too ... to" pattern (too tired to walk), not "too ... that".
wrong.D: "such" takes a noun (such a tired person), not an adjective alone.
